title: Hackers Got Inside a Flock Camera
summary: A security researcher reports that Flock Safety's license-plate-reading cameras, used by law enforcement and neighborhoods, are riddled with vulnerabilities. Hackers reportedly gained access to a camera, exposing weak security practices in a widely deployed surveillance system. The Hacker News discussion (536 points, 245 comments) debates privacy, vendor accountability, and the risks of networked AI-powered monitoring devices.
